title: Fixed fire suppression and exhaust systems for commercial cooking: cleaning, maintenance and qualified persons
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 and NFC(AE) 2023 (National Fire Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: December 2024 (platform created December 16, 2024, last updated December 16, 2024)

facts.text: The interpretation clarifies NBC(AE) and NFC(AE) requirements for fixed fire suppression and exhaust systems for commercial cooking.
The Discussion says it is not obvious from the Code or NFPA 96 whether a ventilation and grease removal system is required in all assembly and care, treatment or detention uses.
The document says the AHJ in the building discipline must be consulted for building permit and professional involvement requirements.
The interpretation replaces 19-FCI-002R1 and is applicable throughout Alberta.

limitations: A published regulator interpretation of a documented design question, not an applicant file.

Joint Fire/Building interpretation; NFPA 96 is cited but not in the package. Replaces 19-FCI-002R1 (earlier STANDATA number; not retrieved).
